body: Does the case convention work with any two letter combinations in the same order? Like instead of project_xy, if it was project_fx, would it still capitalize the FX?

> Does the case convention work with any two letter combinations in the same order? Like instead of project_xy, if it was project_fx, would it still capitalize the FX?

The capitalization of acronyms works according to the remap entries that can be found on **editor_property_name_processor.cpp** on the function **`EditorPropertyNameProcessor()`**. These entries are what remaps the lower case acronym to its uppercase variation. If any string is not found on this map is it capitalized according to normal convention, capitalizing only the first letter.

From my understanding, this needs to be done this way because there is no way to know what is an acronym or not. Simply uppercasing all 2 letter strings would make variables like **`is_awsome`** come out as **`IS Awsome`**, which is not intended. So there really needs to be the map check to find out if it is a recognised acronym or not.

For now, I think most acronyms that are common are recognised by the map, although the **`FX`** that you mention is not, only **`FXAA`**. Everytime new cases appear, like the ones found on the original issue for this PR, they  need to be added onto the map manually. If you think there are more acronyms that should be added maybe there can be a seperate Issue that is created to state more recommendations.
